Hello

On Github, I am primarily known for authoring and maintaining several Neovim plugins.

These days, between work and family I have very little free time available. I can no longer get to every reported issue, so I have implemented a priority queue:

  1. Pull requests - these are the highest priority for me and will be looked at first.
  2. After PRs, I will triage new issues with P0, P1, and P2 labels.
  3. P0 issues will be worked on as soon as possible.
  4. P1 issues may get worked on when I get spare time and feel like it, which is uncommon these days.
  5. P2 issues will not be worked on. Pull requests are the only way to move these forward.

Hi, I'm Joshua 👋

Principal Systems Architect & Engineering Lead
Event-driven platforms · Developer infrastructure · Unreal Engine systems

I've spent 8+ years designing and building developer platforms, runtime systems, and event-driven infrastructure at scale. I'm best known as the creator of QBCore, an open-source multiplayer framework running on thousands of live servers and used by millions of players worldwide. Today I'm building Mantle, a platform for player-made worlds on Unreal Engine 5.

🚀 Featured work

QBCore Framework · Open source

Creator and original architect of the de facto standard framework for multiplayer server infrastructure in its ecosystem.

  • Resource management runtime for loading, isolating, and orchestrating modular server resources
  • Event-driven communication layer connecting server, client, and inter-resource messaging
  • Extensible API framework that lets a large community build and ship on a shared foundation

Mantle · Unreal Engine 5

Founder and sole developer.
Build places in Unreal Engine. Publish them. Play them together.
A platform for player-made worlds built on Unreal Engine 5. Creators build places in the Unreal Editor, publish them to Mantle, and players join through the Mantle client.

  • MantleCore: public UE 5.8 authoring plugin to build, check, upload, and Test locally in the real client
  • Multi-language scripting: gameplay in Luau, TypeScript, or Python against a single Mantle API, plus a visual graph editor
  • Community hosting: creators can run their own Linux or Windows servers for their places

🧠 What I focus on

  • Architecting event-driven systems and platform APIs that other developers build on
  • Developer experience: tooling, extensibility, and frameworks that scale with their communities
  • Real-time and game runtime systems, including Unreal Engine
